mapper.sql: proposal.id, proposal.recruitment_id, proposal.proposer_account_id, proposal.proposer_company_id, proposal.message, proposal.share_profile, proposal.decision, proposal.responded_at, proposal.withdrawn_at, proposal.created_at, proposal.updated_at, recruitment.title AS recruitment_title, recruitment.recruitment_deadline, recruitment.closed_at AS recruitment_closed_at, program.id AS program_id, program.source_code AS program_source_code, program.source_program_id AS program_source_program_id, program.title AS program_title, program.organization AS program_organization, program.summary AS program_summary, program.target_description AS program_target_description, program.application_period_raw AS program_application_period_raw, program.application_start_date AS program_application_start_date, program.application_end_date AS program_application_end_date, program.source_url AS program_source_url, proposer.email AS proposer_email, proposer.email_verified_at AS proposer_email_verified_at, proposer_company.company_name AS proposer_company_name, proposer_company.business_number AS proposer_business_number, proposer_company.region AS proposer_region, proposer_company.industry AS proposer_industry, proposer_company.founded_year AS proposer_founded_year, proposer_company.homepage_url AS proposer_homepage_url, owner.id AS owner_account_id, owner.email AS owner_email, owner.email_verified_at AS owner_email_verified_at, owner_company.company_name AS owner_company_name, owner_company.business_number AS owner_business_number, owner_company.region AS owner_region, owner_company.industry AS owner_industry, owner_company.founded_year AS owner_founded_year, owner_company.homepage_url AS owner_homepage_url

FROM partner_proposal proposal JOIN partner_recruitment recruitment ON recruitment.id = proposal.recruitment_id JOIN support_program program ON program.id = recruitment.support_program_id JOIN account proposer ON proposer.id = proposal.proposer_account_id JOIN company proposer_company ON proposer_company.id = proposal.proposer_company_id JOIN account owner ON owner.id = recruitment.account_id JOIN company owner_company ON owner_company.id = recruitment.company_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO partner_proposal ( recruitment_id, proposer_account_id, proposer_company_id, message, share_profile, decision, responded_at, withdrawn_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{recruitmentId}, #{proposerAccountId}, #{proposerCompanyId}, #{message}, #{shareProfile}, NULL, NULL, NULL, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE proposal.id = #{id} AND proposer.deleted_at IS NULL AND owner.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT
WHERE proposal.proposer_account_id = #{accountId} AND owner.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY proposal.created_at DESC, proposal.id DESC

SELECT
WHERE recruitment.account_id = #{accountId} AND proposer.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY proposal.created_at DESC, proposal.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE partner_proposal SET decision = #{decision}, responded_at = #{respondedAt}, updated_at = #{respondedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND decision IS NULL AND withdrawn_at IS NULL
